stage: CAPS loci excavated by SNP2CAPS with 16 enzymes
outcome_definition: CAPS 'success' in this paper = the primer pair gave a distinct band of the EXPECTED length that was POLYMORPHIC across the three genotypes tested (P1 LSW-177, P2 COS, F1), scored after PCR and restriction digestion. Amplification success (516/532) and expected amplicon size (296) are reported as separate stages and are not the same outcome.
